expect.note: each mutation breaks its own tier and leaves the other two alone

provenance: ground-truth integrity for the whole L4 story. If a mutation silently stopped mutating — a renamed fixture element, a regex that no longer matches — every mutation case would pass for the wrong reason and the self-maintenance evidence would be worthless. Checks are literal substrings of src/browser/fixtures/shop.html. The 'getElementById: false' check was added after l4-shop-ids-renamed went red on first run (2026-08-16): the mutation was renaming ids the fixture's own script depended on, so it broke the page rather than the agent's stable-attr dependency. A fault injector that damages the fixture measures nothing.

triage.note: guards the fault injector, not the product
